searchQueries.title: Search Queries
searchQueries.description: Job titles or keywords to search for. Each query is searched separately and results are de-duplicated across them.

startUrls.title: Start URLs
startUrls.description: Optional. Provide LinkedIn job search URLs directly. When set, these replace the queries and filters above.

maxItems.title: Maximum Items
maxItems.description: Maximum number of jobs to scrape across all queries. LinkedIn serves at most 1000 results per query.

datePosted.title: Date Posted
datePosted.description: Only return jobs posted within this window.

remoteFilter.title: Workplace Type
remoteFilter.description: Filter by remote, on-site, or hybrid work.

includeSalary.title: Show Salary
includeSalary.description: ⚠️ SLOWER: leave this off to keep the scraper at full speed. LinkedIn does not put pay on search result cards, so turning this on means opening every job individually — roughly 10x the requests, and a run that normally takes seconds can take minutes. All jobs are still returned either way; with this off, salary is simply null. About half of postings disclose pay, so the rest stay null even with this on.

scrapeJobDetails.title: Deep Scrape: Job Details
scrapeJobDetails.description: Fetch each job page for the full description, seniority, employment type, skills and apply link. Costs one extra request per job.

scrapeCompanyDetails.title: Deep Scrape: Company Details
scrapeCompanyDetails.description: Fetch each company's About page for industry, size and website. Costs one extra request per unique company, and adds separate records with type 'COMPANY' to the dataset.

outputFields.title: Output Fields
outputFields.description: Restrict dataset records to these fields. Leave empty to keep everything. 'jobId' and 'type' are always kept.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy Configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Residential proxies are strongly recommended for large scrapes. LinkedIn blocks datacenter IPs aggressively.

maxConcurrency.title: Max Concurrency
maxConcurrency.description: Maximum requests in flight at once. Lower this if you see a high block rate.

requestsPerMinuteMultiplier.title: Requests Per Minute Multiplier
requestsPerMinuteMultiplier.description: Request rate cap, calculated as Max Concurrency x this value. Bounds the request rate, which is a separate limit from how many run in parallel.

maxRequestRetries.title: Max Request Retries
maxRequestRetries.description: How many times to retry a blocked or failed request before giving up.

paginationBatchSize.title: Pagination Batch Size
paginationBatchSize.description: Search result pages queued per wave. Higher fetches more pages in parallel but over-fetches more on short result sets.

requestDelayMinMs.title: Request Delay Minimum (ms)
requestDelayMinMs.description: Optional artificial delay before each request. Leave at 0: a delay here holds a concurrency slot open while it waits, so it costs throughput twice over.

requestDelayMaxMs.title: Request Delay Maximum (ms)
requestDelayMaxMs.description: Upper bound of the artificial per-request delay. 0 disables it entirely.

resumeFromPreviousRun.title: Resume From Previous Run
resumeFromPreviousRun.description: Skip jobs and companies already scraped in earlier runs of this actor, using IDs saved in the key-value store.

webhookUrl.title: Webhook URL
webhookUrl.description: Optional. Receives a POST with a JSON payload when the error rate spikes, and on completion if enabled below.

notifyOnCompletion.title: Notify On Completion
notifyOnCompletion.description: Send a webhook when the run finishes. Requires a Webhook URL.
